column3: NKJV includes “Hypocrites!,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has no such address. “A storm” is rendered “foul weather.”
NKJV includes “the prophet,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “the sign of Jonah.”
NKJV has “you have brought no bread,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “you have no bread.”
NKJV has “but to beware,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends with the command “But beware ….”
NKJV reads “that I, the Son of Man, am,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “that the Son of Man is.”
NKJV reads “Jesus the Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “the Christ.”
Close to the Greek; “stumbling block” is rendered “offense.”
Close to the Greek; “give to each according to his deeds” is rendered “reward each according to his works.”
